'''Praetoria Ishu''' was a defensive style of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] developed by the [[Imperial Knight]]s, designed to protect the allies of the [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]] wielder so that they might find openings in an opponent's defenses. Like the more aggressive [[Praetoria Vonil]], it was unique to the Imperial Knights, and placed greater emphasis on teamwork than on one's individual prowess.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
